environment.description: Same application deployed in a Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards set to 'restricted' profile (enforce mode). The namespace label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted' prevents any pod from running with privileged securityContext, hostPath volumes, or as root. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'restrict-volume-types' blocks hostPath and hostPID. The container runs as non-root UID 65534 with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and drops ALL capabilities. A NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the OAuth provider IP range (10.0.50.0/24) and internal cluster DNS. The nginx-ingress is configured with annotation 'nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet' that adds 'proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto https' and forces Strict-Transport-Security. Session cookie store uses secure=true, httpOnly=true, sameSite=Strict.
